description: This file defines the CallSimpleMethod class, which implements functionality for calling a simple method defined in an XML resource within the OFBiz MiniLang framework. It handles parsing of the element, executing the called method, managing scope, and mapping results to fields.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod
classes.description: Implements the <call-simple-method> element for executing a simple method call within the MiniLang framework, including handling scope, result mapping, and artifact gathering.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the call-simple-method operation, invoking the referenced simple method, managing scope, handling errors, and mapping results to environment variables.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information for the referenced simple method for tracking and analysis.
